verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes machine-readable OpenAPI JSON specs at stable URLs. The llms.txt index explicitly lists a "Domains v3 OpenAPI spec — machine-readable Domains contract", and separate spec files exist for Domains v1, v2 and v3, plus Commerce stores, customers, orders, catalog, taxes and channels. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of using the downloaded specs (e.g., with codegen or tooling).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
